bestBets.overview: WON FOR VICKI won a couple in a row before being beaten when odds-on favourite last start. Drawn to sit in behind the speed and she should have last crack last 200m. LUNESSA raced on the speed but just found one better at Roma last start. If she can produce similar she will be competitive in this field. MILK MAID battled on well enough to be just out of placings at Mackay last start. She can sneak a place in this while OAKLAND RAIDER finished in the placings at Mount Isa last start and he is a must for exotics.

bestBets.overview: IOANE jumped to the front and led here yesterday. He fought the race out tenaciously but the in-form Great Cosmic was just a bit too strong. Looks the leader and can win this. LUCKY FORTUNA held her ground without threatening behind Hello World yesterday. This a much easier affair and would not leave her out of winning chances. DEFERENTIAL just gave them too big a start over the 1200m on Friday. He gets extra distance and sure to be hitting line hard. RHESUS comes off a last start win and he will be popular for first four followers.

bestBets.overview: MARAVILLAS was beaten less than 2 lengths at Bowen two starts back then led for a long way before being overran at Mackay last start. May find this a bit easier and he can get away with this. BONDI PROPHET has been racing in consistent in small fields of late but just finding it hard to win. This is no harder and would expect him to be up in first couple for a long way. BOULEVARD BOY battled on well enough when placed yesterday. Only needs to produce similar and he can sneak into exotics again while HI FRANK was brave winning from the front yesterday. He can win again.

bestBets.overview: The time honoured Birdsville Cup is an even race this season. Liked the win of SHISUTA BO at Darwin last start. Drawn to get the perfect run in transit and happy to have something each-way. Expect Paul Hamblin will come across and lead with ACEDROD. Dominant two starts back then beat nice field from the front at Emerald. He is the one to catch. OUR MISSILE was a Mackay winner two starts back before powering him at Cairns. He is the one to watch last 200m while HELLO WORLD finished too well for a gutsy win here yesterday. Rock hard fit and can win again.
